paragraphs.text: Our Deepseek Harness custom plugins, skills and tools
# DSH Plugins
Custom **skills and plugins** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), maintained by sredevopsorg.
The repository publishes two things:
- **Skills** — `SKILL.md` instruction bundles packaged by the **skills plugin** under `plugins/skill
s/skills/`. Install that one plugin and every skill is registered; `install.sh` remains a legacy/man

ual symlink alternative.
- **DSH plugins** — self-contained bundles under `plugins/`, installed from
this repository's release tags **or** browsed from the repository's plugin market index.
| Kind | What it is | Where it lives here |
| **Skill** | A `SKILL.md` (or flat `<name>.md`) instruction bundle loaded on demand by the model or
with `/name`. Skills are packaged and served by a DSH skill-provider plugin. | `plugins/skills/skil

ls/` |
| **Plugin** | A Cordis plugin package loaded into a DSH profile (`dsh plugin …`). | `plugins

/` |
| **Tool** | A model-facing tool registered by a plugin via `ctx.tools`, shipped inside a plugi
n package. | `plugins/entire/` |
The repository also publishes `index.json`, a **format-1 plugin market index** that @deepseek-ai/dsh
-experimental-plugin-market-bundle reads in the Web **Plugins → Discover** tab.
> Verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.x**, currently **`0.2.2-rc.1`**. The CLI version gate is
strict, so check `dsh --version` before reporting plugin issues. Bundle patches are checked against
the installed DSH by `scripts/validate-bundles.mjs`.
## Contents
### Skills

All ten skills ship in the single `skills` plugin. Install it
(see Installing the skills) and the ca
talog lists every row below.
| Skill | Surface | Use it for |
| `software-architecture` | model + user | Choosing the simplest sufficient design, patterns to appl

y or skip, engineering practices, tool/skill selection |
| `fullstack-development` | model + user |
Container-based Python and Node.js/TypeScript backends, frontends, monorepos, Docker, e2e testing |
| `supabase` | model + user | Anything touching Supabase: DB, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storag

e, CLI, MCP, logs, debugging |
| `supabase-postgres-best-practices` | model + user | Postgres schema

, migrations, RLS, indexes, locking, query plans — load *before* touching a database |
| `ghost-them
e-development` | model + user | Authoring Ghost Handlebars themes: templates, contexts, helpers, set

tings, routing, GScan |
| `ghost-theme-modern-frontend` | model + user | Wiring a Ghost theme to Vit

e, Tailwind CSS, and React/Vue/Svelte islands |
| `helm-chart-development` | model + user | Creating

, editing and improving Helm charts: templates, values.yaml, helpers, hooks, CRDs, subcharts |
| `ku
bernetes-kubectl-operations` | model + user | Safe kubectl operations, cluster triage, and opt-in Ku

bernetes MCP inspection |
| `kustomize` | model + user | Kubernetes configuration customization: bas
e/overlay layout, strategic and JSON patches, generators, images, components, replacements, remote b

ases, GitOps rendering |
| `github-actions-security-audit` | model + user | Auditing and hardening G
itHub Actions workflows: token permissions, script injection, `pull_request_target`, action pinning,
runners, supply chain |
### Plugins and tools
| Plugin | Kind | Use it for |
| `code-editor` | bundle + web editor | Browsing a Session's workspace and editing UTF-8 files from

a right-sidebar tab, with sandbox-aware saves and optimistic conflict detection |
| `entire` | bundl
e + tool | Reading Entire sessions, checkpoints, search, trails, and code history, plus capturing DS

H sessions as Entire checkpoints |
| `peak-rate-footer` | bundle + web footer | A green/orange foote
r showing whether DeepSeek API usage is currently billed at peak or off-peak rates, with a local clo

ck, next-change countdown, and in-footer time-zone picker |
| `skills` | bundle + 10 skills | Instal
ling every skill in this repository as one plugin: a packaged skill provider serving the architectur
e, fullstack, Supabase/Postgres, Ghost theme, Helm, Kubernetes, Kustomize, and GitHub Actions skills

|
| `superagent` | bundle + web panel | A vendored fork of DeepSeek Harness's `dsh-superagent` rese
arch prototype: a proactive agent for one GitHub repository (optionally Feishu) that runs tickets in
their own DSH sessions and answers in the original conversation |
## Requirements
- **DSH** — `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh …`, or a global `dsh` install (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`). The Discover f
low additionally needs the experimental **Custom plugin indexes** bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experime

ntal-plugin-market-bundle`), enabled from the Web Plugins page.
- **Node.js ≥ 18** and **npm/npx** —
for the Ghost and Helm toolchain scripts, `npx gscan`, and the optional Kubernetes MCP server (`npx

-y kubernetes-mcp-server@latest`).
- **Ghost 6.x + `gscan`** — only for the two Ghost theme skills.

- **Helm 3+** — only for `helm-chart-development`. No cluster or network needed;
`scripts/verify-ch

art.mjs` shells out to `helm lint` and `helm template`.
- **`kubectl` + a kubeconfig** — only for `k

ubernetes-kubectl-operations`. The skill
inspects and, with explicit confirmation, changes a cluster

UBERNETES_MCP_KUBECONFIG` to an absolute path for a
dedicated, preferably read-only kubeconfig; when

the optional Kubernetes MCP row is
enabled, it passes that value to the server as `KUBECONFIG`. Wit

hout it, the server
uses `KUBECONFIG` or `~/.kube/config`.
- **`kustomize` or `kubectl`** — only for

`kustomize`. Rendering
(`kustomize build <dir>`, or `kubectl kustomize <dir>` when only `kubectl` i

each root and validates the manifest stream.
Pin the same major.minor across local, CI, and GitOps

agents: `kubectl` embeds its
own Kustomize and the two release lines drift independently.
- **Entire

CLI** (`entire`) on `PATH` — only for the `entire` plugin. It records agent sessions and
checkpoint

s and backs every tool; session capture additionally needs the `entire-agent-dsh`
binary and `entire

agent add dsh` in the target repository. Search, trails, and recap also need
an authenticated login

and OS keyring access.
- **`git`** and **`pnpm` 9 or newer** — only when installing DSH plugin pack

ages from this
repository (`dsh plugin …` forwards to pnpm; `path:` subdirectory installs need pnpm
